run_d4pg_continuous: run D4PG agent on a continuous control environment like HalfCheetah-v2 for one million steps
build_experiment_config_d4pg: build a D4PG experiment config with network factory and agent configuration for continuous control
run_distributed_d4pg: run a distributed D4PG experiment with four actors using launchpad and xm docker resources
configure_d4pg_networks: configure D4PG networks with policy and critic layer sizes and distributional value bounds
run_single_threaded_d4pg: run a single-threaded D4PG experiment with periodic evaluation episodes on a gym environment
